title: My Best Friend's Wedding
tagline: Wedding cake for one. Seconds for the critic.
about: A food critic realises she loves her best friend just as he's about to marry someone else.
cue: Serve dessert when Julianne tells Kimmy the creme brulee and jello story.

Wallace Wedding DinnerMy Best Friend's WeddingWedding cake for one. Seconds for the critic.Every recipe serves 4.
    To BeginThe Main EventSomething SweetTo Toast
    To BeginChicago seafood restaurant oystersFresh shucked oysters on crushed ice with an eschalot and cracked pepper dressingHow to make it12 oysters, freshly shucked2 eschalots100ml red wine vinegar1 tsp black peppercorns, cracked2 lemons4 cups crushed iceFinely dice the eschalots and stir into the vinegar with the cracked black peppercorns.Lay the oysters on crushed ice.Spoon a little dressing over each and serve with lemon wedges.Karaoke bar wingsSticky honey, soy and garlic wings, baked crisp, with sesameHow to make it1kg chicken wings1 tsp salt3 tbsp honey2 tbsp soy sauce2 cloves of garlic1 tbsp sesame seedsToss the wings with salt and bake at 220°C until crisp.Warm the honey, soy sauce and crushed garlic until sticky.Toss the wings through the glaze and scatter with sesame seeds.Chicago-mix caramel cheese popcornHalf in baked brown sugar toffee, half in butter and cheddar powder, tossed togetherHow to make itNot on tonight's cookFresh popcorn split in two: half tossed in bubbling caramel and baked crisp, half tossed in butter and cheddar powder, then mixed together in one big bowl.Pop 120g popcorn kernels in oil and split between 2 bowls.For the caramel half, boil 60g butter, 120g brown sugar and 2 tbsp golden syrup for 3 minutes, stir in a pinch of bicarb, toss through one bowl and bake on a tray at 120°C for 30 minutes, stirring twice, then cool.For the cheese half, toss the other bowl with 40g melted butter and 3 tbsp cheddar cheese powder and a pinch of salt.Mix both together in one big bowl.The Main EventFood critic's steakSeared sirloin, cracked pepper cream sauce, thin friesHow to make it1kg potatoes1 L vegetable oil, for frying4 sirloin steaks2 tsp black peppercorns, cracked200ml thickened cream1 bag mixed salad leavessalt, to tasteCut the potatoes into thin fries.Fry the fries twice in the oil until crisp.Season the steaks with salt, sear to your liking and rest.Toast the cracked peppercorns in the pan, add the cream and simmer until thick.Serve the steak with the fries, sauce and a green salad.Union Station deep dish sausage pizzaSemolina dough pressed up a tin, mozzarella, Italian sausage and chunky tomatoHow to make itNot on tonight's cookDeep pan pizza dough pressed into a tin, layered with mozzarella, Italian sausage and chunky tomato sauce, baked at 220°C for 30 minutes.Mix 400g plain flour, 50g fine semolina, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp salt, 60ml olive oil and 250ml warm water, knead 5 minutes and rise 1 hour.Press into an oiled 25cm cake tin and up the sides.Layer 300g sliced mozzarella on the base, then 400g Italian sausage meat pressed flat and browned.Top with a 400g tin crushed tomatoes simmered 10 minutes with garlic and oregano.Sprinkle with parmesan and bake at 220°C for 30 minutes.Rest 10 minutes before cutting.Something SweetCrème brûlée and Jell-OJules says Kimmy could never be Jell-O. Kimmy says she has to be.How to make it1 packet raspberry jelly crystals600ml thickened cream1 vanilla bean6 egg yolks80g caster sugar, for the custard2 tbsp caster sugar, for the topMake up the jelly as the packet says and set in small cups.Heat the cream with the split vanilla bean, whisk into the yolks and sugar, then strain into ramekins.Bake in a water bath at 150°C until just set.Chill the custards until firm.Sprinkle with sugar, torch and serve with the jelly.To ToastI Say a Little Prayer raspberry sparklerGeorge starts the song at lunch and the whole restaurant joins in.How to make it150g raspberries1 tbsp caster sugar1 lemon750ml sparkling wine, coldCrush most of the raspberries with the sugar and lemon juice and push through a sieve.Spoon a spoonful of purée into each of 4 flutes.Slowly top with cold sparkling wine and drop a whole raspberry in each.
